title: Use cross-thread-safe allocator for background generation scratch
description: User-reported editor regeneration failure exposed a Unity allocator thread-affinity defect in background generation. CreatureGenerationScheduler runs generation from a CLR ThreadPool worker via Task.Run, while ImplicitSurfaceInfluenceDomainResolver previously allocated scratch with Allocator.Temp. Replace thread-affine temporary allocation on that path with a worker-safe lifetime policy and retain deterministic disposal. Do not change scheduler ownership or move Unity-object work onto the worker thread.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Fixed in commit c5090942bcead1116a9a4d622e591756b26dd1f2. ImplicitSurfaceInfluenceDomainResolver now uses Allocator.Persistent for its scheduler-worker scratch and disposes it in the existing finally block. Unity execution remains required to close the validation gate; no claim of PlayMode validation is made from this environment. A follow-up performance optimization may replace the per-call persistent allocation with caller-owned/reusable storage only if profiling shows it matters.
